title: RoBiologyDataChoiceQA: A Romanian Dataset for improving Biology understanding of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot and few-shot accuracy metrics across different evaluation sources (Romanian Biology Olympiad versus university medical admission exams) to identify performance disparities resulting from unequal pretraining data exposure.

Qualitative error analysis on questions incorrectly answered by all benchmarked models to identify whether models rely on superficial associative reasoning and frequently co-occurring terms in public corpora rather than nuanced clinical facts.
